intent.proves: No active redirect points at itself, forms a two-step loop, or is a global catch-all.
intent.scope: active redirect rows; exact string comparison without URL normalisation

bindings.reason: Admin query name for redirects not verified; no MCP tool reads redirects.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 u.UrlPathPath + N' -> ' + u.UrlPathRedirect FROM UrlPath u WHERE u.UrlPathActive = 1 AND (u.UrlPathRedirect = u.UrlPathPath OR u.UrlPathPath IN (N'*', N'/*') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UrlPath v WHERE v.UrlPathActive = 1 AND v.UrlPathPath = u.UrlPathRedirect AND v.UrlPathRedirect = u.UrlPathPath))
